title: Expected loss and regulatory capital
text: production query need normal quantile: constants every pool (PD, LGD, correlation, K, RW, floors) computed R emitted pool_params CTE, exposure table joined segment grade. Defaulted rows use ELBE * EAD K = max(0, LGD - ELBE) columns. retail pools homogeneous, query reproduces R row row; corporate pools carry maturity varies inside pool, constants EAD-weighted match exact pool level (header SQL says ). facts can checked DuckDB.

sql <- scr_sql(cap, table = "portfolio", dialect = "duckdb") cat(sql[c(4:9, 12:15)], sep = "
") #> -- CTE pool_params: PD, LGD, correlation, K and RW per pool, computed in R #> --   (floors applied; no normal quantile needed at run time). #> -- CTE exposure_capital: el = pd * lgd * ead, rwa = 12.5 * k * ead per exposure; #> --   rows with defaulted = 1 use ELBE * ead and K = max(0, LGD - ELBE). #> -- NOTE: at least one pool is not homogeneous: its constants are EAD-weighted, so #> --   EL and RWA are exact per pool and approximate per exposure. Pass `grade` for finer pools. #> WITH pool_params AS ( #>   SELECT 'cards_revolver' AS segment, 'G01' AS grade, 0.001 AS pd, 0.75 AS lgd, 0.04 AS r, 0.0036114040962495642 AS k, 0.045142551203119552 AS rw #>   UNION ALL #>   SELECT 'cards_revolver' AS segment, 'G02' AS grade, 0.001 AS pd, 0.75 AS lgd, 0.04 AS r, 0.0036114040962495642 AS k, 0.045142551203119552 AS rw cat(tail(sql, 21), sep = "

what: 2. Calibrating the scorecard to the central tendency
title: PD calibration and rating grades
text: scorecard comes scr_demo fast configuration. hold-event rate 14.5 %, well 9.6 % long-run average panel: sample development window, cycle. scr_calibrate() re-anchors probability central tendency (CT) without touching points: returns new alignment (*, S*) whose predict(..., type = "prob") calibrated PD, scorecard keeps alignment score. Passing scr_dr object target uses long-run average records CT came . Four methods available. "intercept" prior-correction shift King Zeng, refined one-dimensional root mean PD equals CT exactly; slope untouched, every rank statistic untouched. "logodds_ab" "qmm" fit intercept slope ln(odds*) = + b ln(odds), first target accuracy ratio, second accuracy ratio implied PDs . "scaling" proportional rescaling PD * CT / ybar, projected back onto logit map. four hit CT; slope differs, monotone map ln(odds) never changes AUC hold-.

code: library(scorecraft)  cfg <- scr_config("moderate", objective = "risk", nthread = 4)  # Selection: split, triage, binning + screening, multi-strategy consensus res <- scr_select(scr_demo, "default", config = cfg, drop = c("id", "churn"), date_col = "ref_date") res scr_selected(res)                 # the shortlist scr_funnel(res)                   # every input column and the stage it died at scr_leakage(res)                  # suspicious IV and degenerate bins  # Scorecard and alignment: points scorecard, aligned to 600 points at 50:1 with PDO 20 sc <- scr_scorecard(res, challenger = "xgboost") sc sc$alignment                      # ln(odds) = I + S * logit -> score = a + b * logit scr_score_metrics(sc)             # AUC/KS/Gini with bootstrap CI, per sample scr_score_gains(sc, "holdout")    # frozen bands, from the risky to the safe side  # Cut-off, strategy with marginal expected profit, honest reject inference scr_cutoff(sc) scr_strategy(sc, revenue_good = 1080, loss_bad = 4500) scr_reject(sc)  # Coarse classing lab: manual bins and manual variable choice, with a reason lab <- scr_coarse_classing(res) p   <- scr_classing_propose(lab, "ds_region",                             groups = list(edge = c("NORTH", "SOUTH"), core = c("EAST", "WEST", "CENTRE"))) lab <- scr_classing_accept(lab, p, reason = "edge/core is what pricing uses") lab <- scr_classing_choose(lab, drop = "vl_score_10", reason = "not available at decision time") res2 <- scr_classing_apply(lab)      # a new scr_result; scr_scorecard(res2) refits on it scr_decisions(res2)                  # the append-only decision ledger  # Production: R and SQL give the same numbers scr_apply(sc, newdata) cat(scr_sql(sc, table = "prd.customers", dialect = "databricks"), sep = "\n")  # Monitoring, when the analyst decides to run it scr_monitor(sc, newdata, date_col = "ref_date", target = "default")  # Deliverables: four hardened .xlsx workbooks, the SQL files, a Markdown summary scr_export(sc, "output")

code: params <- scr_irb_params("bcb")          # or "basel3_final", "crr3"; editable tables  # Default flag from a monthly panel, then one-year default rates by cohort d  <- scr_default(scr_demo_panel, id = "id", date = "ref_date", dpd = "dpd",                   arrears = "arrears", exposure = "exposure", config = cfg) dr <- scr_default_rate(d, by = "quarter")        # long-run average and its benchmark  # PD: calibrate the scorecard to the central tendency, cut grades, add MoC and the floor cal <- scr_calibrate(sc, target = dr)             # a new alignment; the scorecard is untouched gr  <- scr_grades(sc, calibration = cal, n_grades = 8) gr  <- scr_moc(gr, category = "C", method = "ci_binomial")   # estimation error, computed pd  <- scr_pd(gr, params = params, asset_class = "retail_other") pnl <- merge(d$flags, scr_demo_panel[, c("id", "ref_date", "score")],              by.x = c("id", "date"), by.y = c("id", "ref_date")) scr_pd_validate(pd, pnl, id = "id", date = "date", default = "default", score = "score")  # LGD: workout cash flows -> realised LGD -> cure x severity -> pools -> downturn -> floor wo  <- scr_workout(scr_demo_lgd, scr_demo_lgd_cashflows, rates = scr_demo_rates, config = cfg) lgd <- scr_lgd(wo, drivers = c("product", "ltv", "months_on_book", "prior_dpd_max"), config = cfg) lgd <- scr_lgd_downturn(lgd, periods = data.frame(start = as.Date("2022-01-01"), end = as.Date("2023-12-31")),                         reason = "reference rate above 13% in 2022-2023") lgd <- scr_lgd_floor(lgd, params = params, asset_class = "retail_other")  # EAD: facility snapshots -> realised conversion factors -> pools with the standardised floor rds <- scr_ead_data(scr_demo_ead, facility_id = "facility_id", date_col = "ref_date",                     limit = "limit", drawn = "drawn", defaulted = "defaulted",                     drivers = c("product", "months_on_book"), config = cfg) ead <- scr_ead(rds, drivers = c("product", "utilisation_ref", "months_on_book"), config = cfg)  # Expected loss, risk weights, capital, expected credit loss cap <- scr_capital(scr_demo_portfolio, segment = "segment", asset_class = "asset_class",                    provisions = "provision", params = params, config = cfg) cap$totals; cap$segments hz <- 1 - (1 - scr_demo_portfolio$pd)^(1 / 12)      # annual PD to a monthly hazard scr_ecl(hz, lgd = scr_demo_portfolio$lgd, ead = scr_demo_portfolio$ead, eir = scr_demo_portfolio$eir)  # The same contracts as the scorecard: scoring, SQL, workbooks scr_apply(pd, newdata); scr_apply(lgd, new_defaults); scr_apply(ead, new_facilities)   # each takes the columns its model was fitted on scr_sql(pd, table = "prd.customers", dialect = "databricks") scr_export(pd, "output"); scr_export(lgd, "output"); scr_export(ead, "output"); scr_export(cap, "output")

title: scorecraft: scorecard engine with alignment, cut-off strategy, IRB risk parameters and production SQL — scorecraft-package
text: Split (scr_split()): train/hold-whole periods (--time) supervised fit. Triage (scr_triage()): structural filters, decomposition sentinels missing values, exact duplicates. data leaves NA. Binning screening (scr_bin()): optimal bins parallelised column, eight admission rules, hold-revalidation frozen bins, redundancy pruning. Multi-strategy selection (scr_model()): elastic net, boosting random forest WOE space; consensus weighted hold-Gini. Scorecard (scr_scorecard()): logistic regression shortlist, sign check, points per bin, tree challenger explicitly without points. Alignment (scr_align()): log-odds regression raw score composed PDO map, odds_orientation recorded. Runs automatically inside scr_scorecard(). Cut-strategy (scr_cutoff(), scr_strategy(), scr_reject()): sweep frozen cuts, bands marginal expected profit, honest reject inference sensitivity band. deliverables (scr_export()) audit funnel, gains tables, production SQL (scr_sql()) R-SQL equivalence verified test, four .xlsx workbooks. scr_monitor() recomputes PSI/CSI new data, fixed sample-size-adjusted threshold, never schedules anything .

title: Stage 5: align a raw score to the declared scale — scr_align
text: method = "regression" (default): raw score banded quantiles reference data, empirical log-odds every band computed Laplace smoothing orientation direction implies, regression weighted band size fits $$\ln(\mathrm{odds}) = + S \cdot \mathrm{raw}.$$ absorbs sample reweighting, miscalibration WOE fit prior shift. composes PDO map: $$\mathrm{factor} = \mathrm{pdo}/\ln 2,\quad       \mathrm{offset} = \mathrm{base\_score} - \mathrm{factor}\cdot\ln(\mathrm{base\_odds}),$$ $$\mathrm{score} = \mathrm{offset} + \mathrm{factor}\,(+ S\cdot\mathrm{raw}) = + b\cdot\mathrm{raw}.$$ method = "direct", model assumed calibrated: = 0 S sign direction (-1 higher_is_safer, +1 higher_is_riskier), , ln(odds) raw right orientation.

text: x scr_scorecard() (uses ln(odds) outcome sample), scr_align() (pass raw , two-parameter methods, y) numeric vector event ln(odds) (aligned directly default 600/50/20 scale). target central tendency: number (0, 1) scr_dr scr_default_rate() (lra$mean used). segment, named vector one CT per segment. sample_rate Event rate calibration sample; NULL uses mean y. method "intercept", "logodds_ab", "scaling" "qmm"; NULL uses config$pd_calibration. ar_target Target accuracy ratio "logodds_ab" "qmm". segment Optional vector segment labels, one per calibration row: one alignment per segment fitted well. raw, y Raw ln(odds) 0/1 outcome x scorecard. sample Sample scorecard used calibration.

text: object class scr_pd_calibration: alignment (new scr_align), alignment_before, method, ct, target_source, sample_rate, shift (change event intercept), shift_prior (closed-form King-Zeng shift), slope_ratio (S* / S), mean_pd_before, mean_pd_after, ar_before, ar_after (observed), ar_implied_before, ar_implied_after, n, segments (table alignments segment given), ledger. Also ar_target, note sample.

title: Calibrate the alignment to a central tendency — scr_calibrate
text: "intercept" prior-correction shift King Zeng (2001), \(\delta = \ln[\tau(1-\bar y) / ((1-\tau)\bar y)]\), added event ln(odds); S unchanged, rank order every discrimination statistic untouched. closed form exact odds; calibration sample available shift refined one-dimensional root mean PD equals CT exactly (closed form reported shift_prior). "logodds_ab" Tasche (2013): ln(odds*) = + b ln(odds), (, b) solving mean(PD*) = CT implied accuracy ratio equal ar_target (default: accuracy ratio observed sample). "qmm" Quasi-moment matching: two equations, target accuracy ratio taken PD distribution (implied AR current PDs), outcome needed. "scaling" PD* = PD * CT / ybar. proportional rescaling logit map, slope least-squares projection logit(PD*) ln(odds) intercept solved CT.

title: Calibrate the alignment to a central tendency — scr_calibrate
text: King, G. Zeng, L. (2001). Logistic regression rare events data. Political Analysis, 9(2), 137-163. Tasche, D. (2013). art probability--default curve calibration. Journal Credit Risk, 9(4), 63-103.

title: Pipeline configuration — scr_config
text: two literatures use mathematics opposite conventions. credit fraud, target = 1 bad case scorecard built points mean less risk. propensity, target = 1 good case campaign list needs points mean higher chance engaging. objective touch selection. change modelled target, cut points, IV shortlist; acts direction points scale, odds orientation alignment vocabulary reports. model class event, argument event_level scr_split() scr_select(), one, unlike , rewrites everything.

title: Pipeline configuration — scr_config
text: "jedi" default stays exposed side side alternatives, never hidden behind "auto". Choices distinct properties: "ivb", "dp" "sblp" provably optimal categoricals; "cm" (ChiMerge) "fetb" principled stopping rule; "ir" (isotonic) guarantees monotone WOE; "fast_mdlp" faithful Fayyad-Irani. full list OptimalBinningWoE::obwoe_algorithms(). numeric-categorical-algorithm applies valid type falls back "jedi".

title: Pipeline configuration — scr_config
text: iv_min Admission floor. Fails IV_BELOW_MIN. iv_max Admission ceiling. Fails IV_SUSPICIOUS. 1.00 (default) tolerates legitimately strong predictor cuts absurd; 0.50 engine default, calibrated credit default. iv_suspect threshold report warning. Fails nothing. real leakage detector allow_degenerate = FALSE: bin events non-events symptom innocent explanation.

title: Pipeline configuration — scr_config
text: base_score, base_odds pdo one statement: base_score points odds base_odds, every pdo points double. base_odds always expressed orientation direction implies (non-event:event higher_is_safer; event:non-event higher_is_riskier), alignment object records odds_orientation never implicit. classic 600/50/20 Siddiqi's (2006) textbook example, parameter published bureau. align_method = "regression" (default) takes raw score scale regressing empirical log-odds score bands, absorbs reweighting, miscalibration prior shift; "direct" assumes model calibrated uses logit .

title: Pipeline configuration — scr_config
text: Siddiqi, N. (2006). Credit Risk Scorecards: Developing Implementing Intelligent Credit Scoring. Wiley.

title: Expected credit loss with stage allocation — scr_ecl
text: $$ECL_H = \sum_{t=1}^{H} S(t-1)\, h_t\, LGD_t\, EAD_t\, (1+r)^{-t/12}, \qquad S(t) = \prod_{s \le t}(1 - h_s - p_s)$$ h_t marginal monthly default hazard, p_t optional prepayment hazard r annual effective interest rate (config$ecl_discount = "none" switches discounting ). 12-month figure uses H = config$ecl_horizon_months, lifetime figure full term T. Stage 1 exposures carry 12-month loss, stages 2 3 lifetime loss; stage 3 exposures credit-impaired carry LGD_1 * EAD_1. stage NULL rule : stage 3 dpd >= config$ecl_stage_dpd[2], stage 2 dpd >= config$ecl_stage_dpd[1] 12-month PD now one origination (pd_orig) least config$ecl_sicr_ratio, else stage 1. Scenarios named list shocks applied base inputs, list pd_mult (multiplier hazards, capped one), z (systematic factor one-factor model applied hazards correlation rho, negative bad year), lgd_add (added LGD) ead_mult; weights (normalised one) give probability-weighted result.

title: Validation battery of an LGD model — scr_lgd_validate
text: Calibration. Per pool portfolio, one-sided t-test realised estimated LGD (pool long-run average), -estimation failure: p = 1 - Phi(t); loss shortfall 1 - sum(LGD_real E) / sum(LGD_pred E); coverage realised mean downturn LGD; regression realised predicted. Discrimination. Somers' D / generalised AUC prediction bootstrap interval, compared training value S = (gAUC_init - gAUC_curr) / sigma_curr; Spearman rho; loss capture ratio; R-squared. Stability. PSI pool distribution bins every driver stages, fixed n-adjusted threshold. Pools. Homogeneity within pool (Welch test halves pool split median prediction; small p-value means pool still discriminates) heterogeneity adjacent pools (Welch test; large p-value means pools differ). Traffic lights use p-value thresholds config$pd_lights (shared PD validation) (red first, amber second) fixed PSI thresholds.

what: Margin of conservatism, by category — scr_moc
title: Margin of conservatism, by category — scr_moc
text: Appends entries MoC ledger scr_grades() object. Category "C" (general estimation error) quantified: "ci_timeseries" takes upper bound one-sided level interval long-run average cohort series, \(t_{q, T-1}\, sd(DR_t)/\sqrt{T}\) per grade; "ci_binomial" uses \(z_q \sqrt{PD(1-PD)/n}\) obligors (obligor-years series exists); "bootstrap" resamples outcomes sample within grade takes level quantile default rate estimate. Categories "" (data methodological deficiencies) "B" (changes standards environment) expert quantities: value (one number one per grade, PD units) non-empty reason mandatory. ledger append-: B entries accumulate, new C supersedes previous one (kept active = FALSE).

Main components: features, coef, sign_check, alignment (scr_align object), points, base_points, samples (train hold-: link, prob, score, score_points, y, date), metrics, gains, stability (score variables), calibration, rank_order, challenger, model_card sql. title: Stages 4 and 5: points scorecard, aligned to the declared scale — scr_scorecard
text: engine's WOE event-oriented, every glm coefficient must positive. variable non-positive coefficient (max_abs_coef absolute value) explaining another already explained, sign reversed; removed model refitted, one time, negative first, removal recorded sign_check. last remaining variable never removed: kept flagged NON_POSITIVE_COEF_KEPT_LAST. final shortlist scorecard (features) scr_sql() covers.

title: Stages 4 and 5: points scorecard, aligned to the declared scale — scr_scorecard

title: scorecraft 0.1.0
text: First release. production-grade scorecard engine binary targets, built ‘OptimalBinningWoE’: audit funnel, single configuration, named relaxation, first-class scale alignment, cut-strategy hardened deliverables. Seven stages, exported function, chained scr_select() scr_scorecard(): scr_split(), scr_triage(), scr_bin(), scr_model(), scr_align(), scr_cutoff()/scr_strategy()/scr_reject(). scr_align() first-class stage: banded log-odds regression raw score composed PDO map, odds_orientation recorded, applied engine. runs automatically inside scr_scorecard(). scr_sql() emits production SQL fourteen dialects: pre-processing CTE, WOE/BIN transformation authoritative cut points , scorecard, exact score plus whole points bin index. R-SQL equivalence verified test DuckDB SQLite. scr_bin() parallelised column (nthread), fits merged; result identical serial one. scr_metrics() always reports bootstrap confidence interval AUC/KS/Gini; scr_psi() reports fixed threshold next sample-size-adjusted critical value Yurdakul Naranjo (2020). scr_scorecard(challenger = ) fits tree challenger (xgboost lightgbm) WOE columns, aligned scale, supports_scorecard = FALSE. scr_reject() implements honest reject inference: population scope, band coverage 2x/4x/8x sensitivity band, never parcelling default. scr_monitor() recomputes PSI/CSI (signed points shift) performance vintage new data; never schedules . scr_export() writes four hardened .xlsx workbooks (selection, scorecard, validation, strategy), SQL files Markdown summary. scr_coarse_classing() opens manual binning lab: scr_classing_view(), scr_classing_propose() (breaks, groups, merge, split, missing_to, other_to, reset), scr_classing_accept()/scr_classing_discard() mandatory reason, scr_classing_choose() (keep/drop/force), scr_classing_spec()/scr_classing_read()/scr_classing_import() CSV/xlsx round trip, scr_classing_apply() commit new scr_result, scr_decisions() append-ledger. Manual bins share engine’s contract, scr_scorecard(), scr_apply() scr_sql() follow unchanged; funnel gains provenance. scr_connect() accepts DBI driver next ODBC DSN, scr_fetch() samples server-side dialect-aware random expression.
